english:
Light Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Light Polarity' for 10 seconds. Kinetic or Dark Weapon Kills instead grant a stack of 'Dark Polarity' for 10 seconds. Each buff has a maximum of 5 stacks.

Light Polarity grants 8|16|24|32|40 Grenade Stat at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks. Dark Polarity grants 8|16|24|32|40 Melee Stat at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.

A Weapon Kill of the other alignment removes the previous buff's stacks and starts the other buff at 1 stack.

source.text:
2 Piece | Between Poles

Light Weapon Kills grant a stack of Light Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Light Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Grenade Stat.

Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant a stack of Dark Polarity for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Dark Polarity grants +8 | +16 | +24 | +32 | +40 Melee Stat.

Scoring a Non-Alignment Matching Weapon Kill removes all stacks.
ANY Light Polarity --> Dark Alignment Weapon Kill --> x1 Dark Polarity and x0 Light Polarity.
